from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class ShareCountRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single share count figure reported in a financial statement."""
    company_name: str = Field(description="Name of the company the filing belongs to")
    filing_year: str = Field(description="The fiscal year of the report (e.g., '2023')")
    as_of_date: str = Field(description="The specific date the share count applies to (e.g., 'December 31, 2023')")
    share_type: str = Field(description="The type of share count (e.g., 'Outstanding', 'Issued', 'Treasury')")
    count_value: str = Field(description="The number of shares as reported, preserving format")
    source_section: str = Field(description="Where in the document this figure was found (e.g., 'Balance Sheet', 'Cover Page')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    share_counts: list[ShareCountRecord]
